## What changed and why

Explain the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue (for example, `Fixes #123`).

## Validation

List the checks you ran and the results. Describe anything not tested and why. For visible UI changes, include before/after screenshots without credentials or private data.

## Review notes

Mention migration, saved-data, platform or licensing implications when relevant. Keep the change focused and follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
